evals.prompt: Create an Excalidraw architecture diagram with three connected service cards. Each card must contain a heading plus a four-line responsibility description, and the cards must remain easy to move as units. Save the result as architecture.excalidraw and validate it.
evals.expected_output: A valid architecture.excalidraw file whose text-heavy card copy is grouped with each backing shape, while arrows bind reciprocally to the shapes.
expectations: Every text-heavy interior text element has no containerId and shares a non-empty groupIds value with its backing shape.
No backing shape lists its text-heavy grouped copy in boundElements.
Every connector arrow is reciprocally bound to its source and destination shapes.
The bundled binding audit passes for architecture.excalidraw.

evals.prompt: Create a mixed Excalidraw flowchart named moderation-flow.excalidraw. Use short one-line labels for Start and Complete, but include a detailed moderation step with at least 140 characters of body text inside its rectangle. Connect all three nodes and validate the file.
evals.expected_output: A valid mixed-label diagram: short labels use container bindings, detailed body text uses shape-and-text grouping, and connectors remain bound to shapes.
expectations: The Start and Complete labels use reciprocal container bindings with their shapes.
The detailed moderation text has no containerId, is not in boundElements, and shares a groupIds value with its backing shape.
All text bounds fit within their backing shapes.
The bundled binding audit passes for moderation-flow.excalidraw.
